scope: Prospective digest-only held-out custody admission control; not an external catalog, independent-holder attestation, held-out evaluation, P5 trial, provider, execution, chemistry, aggregation, replication, training, paper, release, or SOTA result.

supported: The new isolated fixture rejects the declared development-reuse, custody, pairing, repetition, duplicate, and control-drift shapes without retaining held-out content.
qualified: A complete synthetic digest-only fixture shape is structurally checked while retaining the original frozen P5 blocker list.
unresolved: No external holder, catalog, attestation, or actual held-out case is available.
All P5 red gates remain active and P5 evaluation remains ineligible.
rejected: A synthetic fixture custody shape establishes external held-out custody, a trial, a component benefit, replication, or SOTA evidence.

failure_ledger.failure: P5 has no independent held-out catalog or commitment, so visible development material could be mislabeled.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: A digest-only fixture control can refuse known development commitments while preserving actual custody as unresolved.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Add an unwired custody shape without creating a catalog or revising P5.
failure_ledger.evidence: P5-F2, P4-RT-02, and focused visible-case commitment refusal.
failure_ledger.result: Focused fixture cases passed; visible development-case reuse and claimed-real custody were refused without external access.
failure_ledger.limitation: Digest checks cannot prove secrecy, independence, or non-leakage outside the checkout.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Replace only with an external custody interface and a new authorized P5 preregistration revision.

failure_ledger.failure: Future paired aggregates can be distorted by an incomplete or drifting sealed matrix before scores exist.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: A no-content key shape should require the frozen 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 pairing and common controls.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Add deterministic prospective shape checks only.
failure_ledger.evidence: Focused duplicate, incomplete, pair, surface, and custody drift fixtures.
failure_ledger.result: Focused fixture cases passed; duplicate, incomplete, pair, surface, and custody drift shapes were refused before any aggregate.
failure_ledger.limitation: No outcome, interval, or statistical analysis is produced.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Retire only if a future scorer proves equivalent or stronger validation over retained raw receipts.

failure_ledger.failure: A fixture-positive custody shape could be overread as external-held-out evaluation.
failure_ledger.hypothesis: The result object must be incapable of reporting P5 eligibility and retain the red-gate list.
failure_ledger.minimal_change: Hard-code false eligibility and use frozen P5 blockers.
failure_ledger.result: Focused fixture cases passed; the complete synthetic shape remained ineligible with every frozen P5 red gate present.
failure_ledger.limitation: This does not solve provider, executor, chemical-result, trial, or replication gates.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Do not relax without separate authorized live-study design and evidence.
